concerns.quote: Failure to carry out ACCT observations recorded in the ACCT log
Five different prison officers purportedly signed various of these entries
In addition, the evidence revealed that the prison officers did not appear to know what their own obligations and responsibilities were in relation to the ACCT procedure and processes
concerns.hazard: lack of understanding of ACCT obligations

concerns.quote: Unless adequate and repeated ACCT training is provided for all officers, particularly for those junior and more inexperienced officers, the lives of vulnerable prisoners will not be safeguarded in accordance with the purpose of the ACCT procedure

reports.title: Roy Sinclair: Prevention of future deaths report

concerns.quote: serious difficulty in the recording, communication, and use of ACCT documentation
no formal policy then in place governing paracetamol overdose
No prison intelligence report was raised after the first reported overdose
debt to other prisoners connected with vapes
serious staffing shortages, recruitment and retention difficulties

links.explanation: Both reports highlight problems with the accuracy and reliability of ACCT documentation that can affect prisoner safety. The earlier report focuses on false recording of observations, while the later report cites broader recording, communication, and use shortcomings.
